service_description: Peinture intérieure standard — main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma national average. Scope per source: light preparation (ponçage, small rebouchage), primer if mentioned in devis, 2 finish coats. Client supplies paint or paint is purchased separately. Measurement: painted wall surface (not floor area — source explicitly explains the calculation method).

service_description: Peinture intérieure standard — main d'œuvre + fournitures (standard paint)
notes: Mano.ma. Standard all-in price for interior walls including standard paint (vinyl/acrylic, brand not specified). Measurement basis explicitly stated as wall surface in source — source provides the formula: (perimeter × height) minus openings.

service_description: Peinture extérieure façade — main d'œuvre + fournitures
notes: Mano.ma. Exterior facade painting including weather-resistant paint. Measurement: actual painted facade surface. Higher cost due to: technical products, surface preparation, potential scaffolding, 2–3 coats. Scaffolding NOT included in this range — may be additional.

service_description: Peinture décorative — tadelakt, béton ciré (main d'œuvre + fournitures)
notes: Mano.ma. Decorative finishes: tadelakt, béton ciré. High artisan skill required. Price depends heavily on artisan experience. This is a QUOTE_REQUIRED category.

service_description: Peinture plafond — main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma. Ceiling painting labour only. Lower than wall rate due to simpler preparation usually. Measurement: ceiling surface area (= floor area of room).

service_description: Peinture mur — supplément décapage ancienne peinture écaillée
notes: Mano.ma. Additional charge for stripping deteriorated or peeling old paint before repainting. Not included in standard rates.

service_description: Sous-couche / primaire — supplément si non inclus
notes: Mano.ma. Primer/undercoat surcharge when not included in base quote. Common with informal artisans (maâlem) who may omit primer.

service_description: Casablanca — peinture intérieure main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma city-level data. Casablanca highest-cost city in Morocco for painting labour.

service_description: Casablanca — peinture façade main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma city data. Casablanca facade labour only.

service_description: Rabat/Salé — peinture intérieure main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma city data.

service_description: Marrakech — peinture intérieure main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma city data.

service_description: Fès/Meknès — peinture intérieure main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma city data. Lower-cost cities.

service_description: Budget simulation — appartement 100m² surface peinte — main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma simulation table: 100m² painted surface, labour only. NB: surface means PAINTED SURFACE not floor area. Source explicitly clarifies.

service_description: Budget simulation — appartement 100m² surface peinte — gamme standard (tout compris)
notes: Mano.ma simulation: 100m² painted surface, standard paint all-in. Cross-check: 9000/100 = 90 DH/m² and 13000/100 = 130 DH/m² — consistent with EV-002 upper range.

service_description: Peinture plafond — main d'œuvre seule
notes: Mano.ma ceiling guide. Note: higher than EV-005 (SRC-004 general guide gave 20–35 MO only for plafond). The ceiling-specific guide gives 40–80 MO only — difference may reflect full professional scope including enduit lissage vs labour-only minimal scope. Important ambiguity flagged.

service_description: Peinture plafond — tout compris (MO + fournitures)
notes: Mano.ma ceiling guide. Wide range due to state of ceiling and enduit lissage inclusion.

service_description: Peinture plafond avec enduit de lissage inclus
notes: Mano.ma. Enduit de lissage is commonly required in Morocco (béton brut ceilings) and often billed separately. The standard Moroccan quote often includes 2 passes of enduit lissage in the all-in rate.

service_description: Peinture plafond humide (peinture anti-humidité)
notes: Mano.ma. Anti-humidity ceiling treatment. Note: this covers paint application only. If underlying moisture source is active, this is NOT an appropriate FIXEO service — requires plombage/toiture diagnosis first.

service_description: Peinture vinyle mate — tout compris
notes: Bnidari.ma. Economy tier: vinyl/matte paint. Suitable for ceilings or low-traffic areas. Includes basic paint material at budget quality.

service_description: Peinture satinée lavable — tout compris
notes: Bnidari.ma. Washable satin — standard quality for living rooms and bedrooms in Morocco. Uses brands Astral, Colorado, Atlas.

service_description: Peinture décorative (yakout, ambra, tadelakt, effet sablé)
notes: Bnidari.ma. Decorative finishes. 'Depends strongly on artisan skill level.' This is a QUOTE_REQUIRED category.

service_description: Tarif peintre moyen constaté — national Maroc
notes: Bnidari.ma platform tariff page. Stated as 'prix moyen constaté'. Wide range covers economy to premium scope. Includes: floor/furniture protection, enduit lissage, primer, 2 finish coats, site cleanup. Measurement basis: painted surface (inferred from context, not explicitly stated).

service_description: Peinture intérieure standard — tout compris (travauxpeinture.ma)
notes: Travauxpeinture.ma FAQ answer. Stated as interior standard. Measurement basis NOT specified by source — could be painted surface or floor area. FIXEO must not assume. Brands mentioned: Valentine, Tollens, Caparol (premium brands — this could inflate the range vs budget paint).

service_description: Tadelakt — tout compris
notes: Travauxpeinture.ma FAQ. Tadelakt waterproof lime plaster. Measured on applied surface. QUOTE_REQUIRED for FIXEO.

service_description: Casablanca 2015 — mur intérieur vinylique
notes: Mondevis.ma real competing quotes from 2015. 150m² stated as 'surface totale des murs en m²' — explicitly PAINTED_SURFACE_M2. Multiple quotes received. Older data; current prices are higher. Shows labour+material bundled but breakdown unclear per quote.

service_description: Casablanca 2015 — plafond peinture (glycéro/vinyle)
notes: Mondevis.ma 2015 real quotes. Ceiling prices separately listed in devis. 2015 baseline — current prices estimated 30–50% higher.

service_description: Peinture plastique extérieure 2 couches (construction neuve) — Maroc public procurement
notes: Prix-construction.info Moroccan database. Public procurement reference price. Primer coat + 2 finish coats of plastic exterior paint on cement render. Measured on actual painted surface per project documentation. Does NOT include scaffolding. Represents a structured, documented unit price with overhead.

service_description: Peinture anticarbonatation (spécialité béton extérieur) 2 couches — Maroc public procurement
notes: Prix-construction.info. Specialty anti-carbonation paint for concrete structures. Public procurement reference. Lower total cost because material (elastomeric paint) is thin (0.2 kg/m² per coat). Not a residential interior paint reference.

service_description: Appartement Casablanca 100m² (plancher) — tout compris — valeur communautaire
notes: Reddit r/Morocco August 2025. User reports 17,000 DH for 100m² apartment (2 bedrooms, kitchen, salon, 2 balconies, ceilings) all-in. The 100m² here refers to FLOOR AREA. Painted wall surface for such an apartment would be approximately 220–250m². Cross-check: 17,000 / 240m² painted ≈ 70 DH/m² painted surface — consistent with EV-002 upper range. Grade D, use with caution.

service_description: Matériau — Colorado Colovinyl 900 (peinture vinylique standard)
notes: Bricoma retail price for Colorado Colovinyl 900 standard vinyl paint. Retail pricing. At ~12m²/L (2 coats): 15L covers ~180m² => 439/180 ≈ 2.4 MAD/m² material only. Economy-tier paint material is very cheap — labour dominates the quote.

service_description: Peinture mur — hauteur >3m supplément échafaudage
notes: Mano.ma. Surcharge for access heights 3–5m requiring tubular scaffolding. Beyond 5m requires professional scaffold rental.

service_description: Enduit de lissage — supplément si non inclus dans devis peinture
notes: Mano.ma. Enduit de lissage (skim coat) is commonly required in Morocco especially on raw concrete surfaces. Often listed separately in professional devis.
